description: This file contains shell script functions for managing firmware upgrades on Linksys devices. It includes logic to determine the target firmware partition, perform the upgrade, and copy configuration backups.

methods.name: linksys_get_target_firmware
methods.description: Determines the target firmware partition (kernel1 or kernel2) based on current boot environment and UBI partition info.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_linksys
methods.description: Performs firmware upgrade for Linksys device, identifying firmware partition and executing the appropriate upgrade method.

methods.name: platform_copy_config_linksys
methods.description: Copies backup configuration files to the appropriate location for the upgrade process.
